name: AMI Meeting Corpus
description: A corpus of approximately 100 hours of multiparty meeting recordings, including audio, video, transcripts, and annotations, created to support research on meeting understanding and recognition.
citation: Carletta, J., Ashby, S., Bourban, S., et al. (2005). The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-announcement. In Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Machine Learning for Multimodal Interaction (MLMI 2005), 28–39. https://doi.org/10.1007/11550617_3
